title: Vietnam Mountain Marathon 2026 リザルト — DogsorCaravan
claims: The report says the 13th VMM was held from 18 to 20 September 2026 with more than 5,300 runners from 54 countries and was the eighth stop of the 2026 World Trail Majors.
The 100km started at 05:00 on Saturday from Sapa Square over a 101 km course with 5,500 m of gain.
Man Kumar (Roka Magar Man Kumar, NEP) won the 100km in 11:42:37, a course record, ahead of Aleksei Beresnev (RUS) 13:06:24 and Ngô Văn Chính (VIE) 13:28:05.
Hà Thị Hậu (VIE) won the women's 100km in 12:54:43, also a course record and second overall, ahead of Maryline Nakache (FRA) 14:29:54 and Ying Li (CHN) 14:53:49.
The 50km, part of the WTM Short Series, is 49.6 km with 2,700 m of gain and was won by Ruqin Wang (CHN) in 4:59:27.
